title: Whole-CH combined gmapsupp crashed Edge 1040 (forced reset)
description: Copying swiss-glo30-tlm.img (264MB, 112 detail tiles TRE, whole-country embedded DEM, custom style+TYP) to a Garmin Edge 1040 crashed it badly -> full device reset required. No on-device diagnostics available. Confirmed via FAT parse: 112 TRE tiles + DEM subfiles, NO NET/NOD (routing not involved). Likely trigger: sheer size/tile-count/DEM overwhelming the device at boot-time map indexing, but custom TYP/style and embedded DEM are also unverified-on-device. ACTIONS: (1) verify all maps on desktop (QMapShack/BaseCamp) before any device load; (2) only load SMALL single-region maps on the device; (3) isolate the cause with a tiny-region matrix: hillshade-only / vector-only(default style) / vector+our TYP / combined; (4) add a guardrail warning when a build is very large / many-tile for a device. DO NOT ship whole-country gmapsupp to a device.

title: Make DEM optional: vector-only .IMG from --tlm without --dem-dir
description: The pipeline currently requires --dem-dir. swissTLM3D-only data (no DEM) must build a vector .IMG: derive WGS84 bounds from the TLM source instead of the DEM mosaic, skip HGT generation, and run mkgmap without --dem. Require at least one of --dem-dir/--tlm.
close_reason: DEM-optional + splitter implemented and verified end-to-end. Vector-only build derives bounds from the TLM extent (vector.tlm_bounds via ogrinfo + gdaltransform), skips HGT, runs mkgmap without --dem. Large OSM (> SPLIT_NODE_THRESHOLD nodes) is tiled with splitter.jar (auto-downloaded, SHA-pinned) then mkgmap combines tiles into one gmapsupp. Required fixing OSM node ordering for splitter (ascending positive ids, nodes-before-ways). Verified: small sample vector-only (4s) and a 40x30km subset -> 5.16M nodes -> 4 tiles -> 6.8M gmapsupp. 30 tests pass.

title: mkgmap output is a bare tile, not a loadable gmapsupp.img
description: pipeline copies mkgmap's 63240001.img detail tile to --out, but a lone tile renders EMPTY on Garmin devices (Fenix) and makes QMapShack warn 'Mapping a file beyond its size is not portable'. mkgmap must be run with --gmapsupp (+ family-id/product-id/mapname/country-name) to produce a self-contained gmapsupp.img that bundles the detail tile + overview (TRE/RGN/LBL/DEM). Fix mkgmap.build_img_cmd to emit gmapsupp.img and return it.
notes: Resolution clarified: the gmapsupp.img change is a genuine correctness improvement (single loadable product for Garmin devices vs a bare detail tile). HOWEVER the reported 'renders empty' symptom was NOT caused by the bare tile -- it was viewing the wrong coordinates (small 2km extent off-screen). The QMapShack 'mapping beyond its size' warning is benign (IMG partition declared 1x512B block larger than file). Map output is valid; verified RGN populated + correct TRE bounds.
close_reason: mkgmap.build_img_cmd now runs --gmapsupp with family/product/mapname; pipeline copies the self-contained gmapsupp.img. Rebuilt sample -> 62K gmapsupp with detail+overview subfiles. 25 tests pass.

title: v1: Swiss DEM → Garmin hillshading .IMG pipeline
description: Python orchestrator that turns a local dir of swissALTI3D GeoTIFF tiles (EPSG:2056) into a Garmin .IMG with hillshaded relief. Pipeline: gdalbuildvrt → gdalwarp (reproject 2056→4326, downsample to ~1 arc-sec, -tap) → gdal_translate -of SRTMHGT per 1° tile → synthesize minimal bounds.osm → mkgmap --dem. Shell out to GDAL CLI (not osgeo bindings). Auto-download+cache pinned mkgmap jar (SHA-verified). Java>=1.8 required. See /home/marcus/.claude/plans/we-need-digital-elevation-fizzy-hammock.md
notes: v1 pipeline implemented and verified end-to-end on synthetic EPSG:2056 DEMs (cold-cache run: download+SHA-verify mkgmap r4924 -> HGT 3601x3601 -> mkgmap --dem -> DEM-embedded .img). 14 unit tests pass (hgt tiling geometry + GDAL/mkgmap argv construction). Edge-tile margin + dstnodata voids handle mkgmap's out-of-bounds DEM border. REMAINING: manual visual confirmation on REAL swissALTI3D + BaseCamp/device (no automated substitute) before closing.
close_reason: Verified end-to-end on real swissALTI3D (0.5m) and confirmed rendering as 'topovert' on a Garmin device. Implemented in commit 1df08d1.

title: Austria slice 1: Vorarlberg + Tirol
description:
First Austrian target extent (user scope, 2026-08): Vorarlberg + Tirol incl. Osttirol,
roughly lon 9.50..12.99 / lat 46.60..47.80. Parent research: topovert-7cd.
Everything below verified against live endpoints; all sources CC BY 4.0.

Key consequence of narrowing to VBG+T: KM50-V is OUT. Its published tiles are
Weinviertel/Marchfeld and S-Carinthia/S-Styria only (1420-2/3, 1520-0, 1550-2/3,
1640-0, 1650-2) - zero overlap with VBG/T. But the two provinces publish their own
open data, which closes the land-cover gap the nationwide DLM leaves open, and for
Vorarlberg beats swissTLM3D on hiking trails.

DEM
  BEV ALS DTM 1 m covers the extent with 18 distinct 50 km EPSG:3035 tiles
  (N2600000/2650000/2700000 x E4250000..4550000), ~1.2 GB each => ~22 GB.
  1 m is heavy overkill for an mkgmap DEM embed (SRTM1 grid ~30 m), so either
  downsample on ingest or prefer the lighter provincial models:
  VoGIS Gelaendehoehenmodell Vorarlberg 5 m / 10 m / 25 m, and tiris
  "Laserscan Download Tirol". Copernicus GLO-30 (already supported) remains the
  zero-work fallback.

VECTOR - network, POIs, water, buildings
  BEV DLM as in topovert-7cd, clipped to the extent with ogr2ogr -spat (the 1.3 GB
  DLM_1000_VERKEHR gpkg clips fine; see topovert-05p which wants the same for CH).

VECTOR - hiking trails (this is where the provinces win)
  Vorarlberg, VoGIS WFS, verified GetFeature returns GeoJSON in EPSG:31254:
    https://vogis.cnv.at/geoserver/vogis/wander_wege/ows?service=WFS&version=1.0.0
      &request=GetFeature&typeName=wander_wege&outputFormat=application/json
    9852 segments, weg_art/weg_katego = 1 "Spazier-, Wanderweg (gelb-weiss)" (6061),
    2 "Bergwanderweg (weiss-rot-weiss)" (3532), 3 "Alpiner Steig (weiss-blau-weiss)" (259).
    Maps straight onto sac_scale + trail_visibility, i.e. three distinct TYP line styles.
    Also carries gehzeit_ri/gehzeit_ge (both directions), hm_auf_ri, laenge_3d, tafel_1/2.
    Companion layers: wander_tafeln (signposts), wander_tafel_nr, wander_gehzeit.
    ogr2ogr reads WFS directly - no new dependency, fits the CLI-only rule.
  Tirol, tiris ArcGIS Hub, direct GeoPackage download:
    https://data-tiris.opendata.arcgis.com/api/download/v1/items/a3b8885df1d44c45bd7c1afe87cfecaa/geoPackage?layers=0
    Layer "Verkehrswege" (same GIP.at source as VBG). OBJEKTBEZEICHNUNG classes include
    "Radweg, Fussweg, Wanderweg", "Forstwirtschaftlicher Weg", "Wirtschaftsweg",
    "Singletrail Strecke", plus every road/rail class with "- Bruecke" /
    "- Tunnel / Galerie" baked into the label (free bridge/tunnel tagging).
    Weaker than VBG: no trail difficulty and no Gehzeit - foot/bike/hiking are one class.

VECTOR - land cover (closes the DLM Bodenbedeckung gap for this extent)
  Wald  Tirol : "Waldflaeche" (DKM Wald + orthophoto mapping, corrected by Revierfoerster)
                https://services3.arcgis.com/hG7UfxX49PQ8XkXh/arcgis/rest/services/Waldflaeche/FeatureServer/0
        VBG   : WFS waldflaeche_oek (OeK50 forest layer) or the BFW "Hochgenaue
                Waldkarte" (ALS+orthophoto, annual) - vogis layer bfw_waldkarte
  Gletscher   Tirol "Gletscher" FeatureServer; VBG WFS gletscher_2012
  Gewaesser   Tirol "Fliessgewaesser"/"Seen"; VBG gewaessernetz2017_* + fluesse_fl
  Fels        STILL THE GAP. VoGIS only has a 1-bit raster ("Felsdarstellung der
              topographischen Karte 1:50.000", topo_fels.tif, no download service).
              Best vector option stays BEV Kataster Nutzungsflaechen, whose Nutzung
              list separates "Fels- und Geroellflaechen", Krummholz and Gletscher.
              Tirol "Landnutzung" (LISA-derived) does NOT help: its 19 classes have
              Wald, Gletscher and Gewaesser but lump rock into
              "Natuerliche Flaechen - diverse".

Catalogue APIs (both GeoNetwork, both need Accept AND Content-Type application/json
or they answer HTTP 400):
  BEV   POST https://data.bev.gv.at/geonetwork/srv/api/search/records/_search   (1633 recs)
  VoGIS POST https://vogis.cnv.at/geonetwork/srv/api/search/records/_search      (846 recs)
  tiris GET  https://data-tiris.opendata.arcgis.com/api/feed/dcat-us/1.1.json    (102 datasets)

Attribution required by CC BY: BEV, Land Vorarlberg, Land Tirol (and BFW if its
Waldkarte is used).

title: Austria support: BEV open data (DLM + KM50-V + ALS DTM)
description:
Research outcome (2026-08): BEV open data IS suitable for a topovert-quality Austrian map,
but no single BEV product is a swissTLM3D equivalent. Everything below is CC BY 4.0
("Fuer dieses Produkt gilt die Standardlizenz CC-BY-4.0"), direct HTTPS download from
data.bev.gv.at, no login. Catalogue is queryable: POST
https://data.bev.gv.at/geonetwork/srv/api/search/records/_search (needs BOTH
Accept: application/json and Content-Type: application/json, else HTTP 400).

DEM (replaces --dem-dir / --dem-area):
  ALS DTM 1 m, airborne laserscan, nationwide, 55 COG tiles on a 50 km EPSG:3035 grid, e.g.
  /download/ALS/DTM/20250915/ALS_DTM_CRS3035RES50000mN2700000E4300000.tif  (~1.2 GB/tile,
  ~68 GB for AT). Tile index: /download/ALS/ALS_Kacheluebersicht.zip. Far better than
  Copernicus GLO-30; needs downsampling before HGT for country-scale builds.
  Coarse fallbacks: BEV DGM 10/50/100/250/500 m.

VECTOR, option A - DLM (nationwide, GeoPackage, EPSG:31287):
  /download/DLM/DLM_20260323/DLM_<n>_<THEME>_<date>.gpkg
  1000_VERKEHR (1.3 GB), 2000_BAUTEN, 3000_GEBIETSNUTZUNG, 4000_GEWAESSER,
  5000_BODENBEDECKUNG (77 MB), 7000_NAMEN, 8000_BAUWERK.
  Attribute model is friendlier than swissTLM3D: integer F_CODE *plus* readable F_NAME in
  the data (no external Objektkatalog needed). Plus LAGE (Ebenerdig/Bruecke/Tunnel/Galerie)
  and STUFE (-4..4) -> maps to OSM bridge/tunnel/layer, which vector.py does not do for CH.
  Covers: roads 1101-1143 incl. Fahrweg/Traktorweg/Fussweg/Fussspur/Fussweg breit;
  rail 1301-1306; lifts 1401-1409; watercourses 4101-4104; POIs incl. 2216 Schutzhuette,
  2212 Biwakschachtel, 2222 Hoehle, 4303 Quelle, 4306 Wasserfall, 2313 Gipfelkreuz;
  buildings BWK_8101_BAUWERK_F; names incl. 7302 Berggipfel, 7304 Uebergang.
  GAP (verified by downloading the gpkg): DLM_5000_BODENBEDECKUNG has exactly one feature
  layer BOD_5300_WASSER_F = water + Gletscher only. NO forest, NO rock/scree, NO wetland.
  DLM_3000_GEBIETSNUTZUNG is protected areas/leisure/traffic/industry, not land cover.
  So a DLM-only map loses the green/grey/rock fills that carry the Swiss map's topo look.

VECTOR, option B - KM50-V (the OeK50 cartographic vector model, best quality):
  /download/KM_V/KM50/<date>/KM50_V_<sheet>_CRS258 3x...zip (~6 MB/tile, GeoPackage + QGIS
  project + SVG symbols). 43 layers incl. KM50_BODEN_FL (land cover), KM50_FELSEN_FL (rock),
  KM50_SCHICHTEN_LN (contours with HOEHE_TIEFE + index/normal KAT), KM50_WEG_LN and
  KM50_WEGMARK_LN with WEGMARKIERUNG / WEGNAME / WEGKURZBEZ_KARTE (E8, 07, NLW, 630 ...),
  plus a SCHUMMERUNG hillshade tile pyramid.
  BLOCKER: multi-year rollout, only ~7 of 59 tiles published (Weinviertel/Marchfeld and
  S-Carinthia/S-Styria: 1420-2, 1420-3, 1520-0, 1550-2, 1550-3, 1640-0, 1650-2). Tirol,
  Salzburg, Hohe Tauern not yet available.

Land-cover gap fillers (pick one, in preference order):
  1. KM50-V_WALD_SHP_20210701.zip (330 MB) - legacy nationwide 1:50k forest from the old
     KM50-V, /download/KM_V/KM50/20210701/. Forest only, no rock.
  2. Kataster Nutzungsflaechen (DKM, CC BY, GeoPackage per KG) - Benuetzungsart/Nutzung
     includes Wald, Fels- und Geroellflaechen, Krummholz, Gletscher, alpines Gruenland.
     Parcel-based so edges follow property lines, not the terrain.
  3. BEV Land Cover raster 20 cm, 6 classes (high/mid/low vegetation, buildings, bare
     ground, water) - /download/LC/. Needs raster->polygon, classes are coarse.
  4. OSM landuse=forest / natural=* - best cartographic match, different licence (ODbL).

Recommendation: DLM for the network + POIs + water, --contours from ALS DTM (we already
have gdal_contour), and gap-fill forest+rock from (1)+(2). Treat KM50-V as an opt-in
"best where available" source once BEV finishes the rollout.

Work this implies (split into child issues when starting):
  - generalise vector.py: source-specific layer/TAG_MAP profiles (CH swissTLM3D vs AT DLM),
    source CRS 2056 vs 31287, attribute name OBJEKTART vs F_CODE
  - LAGE/STUFE -> bridge/tunnel/layer tags (also improves CH once TLM equivalents wired)
  - dem_download: BEV ALS DTM 50 km EPSG:3035 grid alongside Copernicus GLO-30
  - style/TYP: reuse as-is, the emitted OSM tags are the same vocabulary
  - attribution: CC BY 4.0 requires naming BEV in the map/README

title: Allow contours without embedding the hillshade DEM (--no-hillshade)
description: Currently --contours requires --dem-dir, and any --dem-dir build always generates HGT tiles and passes --dem to mkgmap, embedding the (large) DEM for hillshading. Add --no-hillshade so a user can derive contour lines from the DEM but skip the heavy DEM embed, yielding a much smaller contour-only .IMG. The DEM mosaic is still built (for bounds + gdal_contour); only HGT generation + --dem are skipped, and the SRTMHGT driver is then not required.
close_reason: Added --no-hillshade: pipeline now always builds the DEM mosaic (for bounds + gdal_contour) but only generates HGT tiles and passes --dem to mkgmap when hillshading. --contours --no-hillshade yields a lightweight contour-only .IMG; SRTMHGT driver no longer required in that mode. Guard rejects --no-hillshade with only --dem-dir (empty map). CLI summary now lists hillshade/contours/vectors. Verified end-to-end on synthetic LV95 DEM: contour-only build emits no --dem, no HGT tiles, smaller output. Docs updated; 45 tests pass.

title: --source-epsg can't differ between --dem-dir and --tlm
description: pipeline.build threads ONE source_epsg into both make_hgt_tile (DEM) and vector.build_features_osm/tlm_bounds (TLM). A combined build with a 4326 DEM (e.g. Copernicus GLO-30) + a 2056 swissTLM3D GDB is impossible: the single --source-epsg mis-labels one input (ogr2ogr -s_srs 4326 on LV95 coords -> garbage geometry off-map). Fix: detect each source's CRS from the data (gdalinfo/ogrinfo) and drop --source-epsg, or add separate --dem-epsg/--tlm-epsg. Found building whole-CH GLO-30 + swissTLM3D.
notes: Autodetection is easy. Make source_epsg Optional[int]=None (=auto). When None: OMIT -s_srs in gdal_tools.warp_tile_cmd and vector.ogr_geojson_cmd -- GDAL/OGR then read the source's own embedded CRS (verified both GLO-30 4326 tiles and the LV95 GDB carry it), which fixes the combined 4326-DEM + 2056-TLM case with no detection logic. Keep the int override for sources lacking CRS metadata. Only tlm_bounds (vector-only path) needs a numeric EPSG for gdaltransform: detect it there. 'gdalsrsinfo -o epsg --single-line <raster>' works (returns EPSG:NNNN) but does NOT accept a vector layer arg (tried 'gdalsrsinfo ... <gdb> TLM_STRASSE' -> 'failed to load SRS from TLM_STRASSE'); for a GDB layer parse ogrinfo -json -so <src> <layer> .layers[].geometryFields[].coordinateSystem.wkt for the trailing ID["EPSG",NNNN]. Add tests for cmd builders with source_epsg=None (no -s_srs) and a tlm_bounds detection unit test.
close_reason: Implemented CRS auto-detection. source_epsg defaults to None: warp_tile_cmd + ogr_geojson_cmd omit -s_srs (GDAL/OGR read the file's own CRS); tlm_bounds detects the layer WKT via ogrinfo -json and passes it to gdaltransform (robust to the compound LV95+LN02 CRS). --source-epsg kept as a both-inputs override. Verified end-to-end: 4326 GLO-30 + 2056 swissTLM3D with no --source-epsg -> features at correct WGS84 coords, valid img. 40 tests pass; README workaround removed.

title: Clip swissTLM3D vector export to target/DEM bounds (ogr2ogr -spat)
description: vector.ogr_geojson_cmd has no -spat; build_features_osm passes 'bounds' only into the OSM <bounds> header, so a combined --dem-dir + --tlm build exports the ENTIRE TLM source regardless of DEM extent. Add -spat (bounds in EPSG:4326, with -spat_srs) so the DEM tiles drive the vector area and combined regional builds stay cheap. Found while building whole-CH from the 10.7GB country gpkg.

title: Build whole-Switzerland DEM+vector IMG (GLO-30 + swissTLM3D)
description: Full-country combined build: 18 GLO-30 tiles (EPSG:4326) hillshade + whole swissTLM3D GeoPackage (10.7GB, EPSG:2056) vector overlay -> single gmapsupp via splitter+mkgmap. Heavy (100M+ nodes).
close_reason: Built whole-Switzerland DEM+vector gmapsupp (252MB, swiss-glo30-tlm.img): GLO-30 reprojected to EPSG:2056 (to match swissTLM3D) + the 5.3GB whole-CH GDB. 8 layers -> 166.9M nodes -> splitter 112 tiles (16g heap) -> mkgmap with DEM+TYP -> valid gmapsupp (TRE/RGN/LBL/NET/NOD/DEM/TYP/MDR) in ~31min. Documented the combine-with-swissTLM3D workflow + CRS caveat in README. 38 tests pass. Hit + filed the shared --source-epsg limitation (topovert-0zt). On-device visual check still pending (no GUI).

title: Build + document a Copernicus GLO-30 (EPSG:4326) hillshade IMG
description: Demonstrate the coarse-DEM path: build a Switzerland Garmin .img from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 tiles via --source-epsg 4326, and document choosing a DEM source in the README. Motivated by swissALTI3D 0.5m being terabytes for the whole country while the pipeline downsamples to ~30m anyway.
close_reason: Built a whole-Switzerland hillshade from Copernicus GLO-30 (18 tiles, EPSG:4326, --source-epsg 4326): valid 90MB gmapsupp.img with DEM+TYP subfiles in ~52s, fully offline (mkgmap/splitter cached). Documented the coarse-DEM choice (Copernicus GLO-30 / swissALTI3D 2m, geoid datum caveat) in README 'Choosing a DEM source'. 38 tests pass incl. doc guards. On-device/QMapShack visual check still pending (no GUI here), tracked with the other hillshade visual checks.

title: Make Garmin map name fully configurable (family/series/description, country)
description: The on-device map name is effectively fixed. --name (default 'topovert') only feeds mkgmap --description (mkgmap.py:46); --country-name is hardcoded 'Switzerland' (mkgmap.py:49); --family-name/--series-name are never set, yet those are what a Garmin device shows in its map list. Make the map name flow into --family-name/--series-name/--description, and make country configurable. Keep family-id/product-id/mapname numeric identity separate.
design: Thread a single --name (and optional --country) from cli -> pipeline.build -> mkgmap.build_img_cmd. Set --family-name and --series-name to the name (not just --description). Drop the hardcoded --country-name=Switzerland in favor of a param (default Switzerland).

title: Adopt uv for dev/build workflow (keep hatchling backend)
description: Switch dev/dependency workflow to uv while keeping hatchling as the PEP517 build backend. Migrate [project.optional-dependencies] dev -> [dependency-groups] dev, generate+commit uv.lock, update CLAUDE.md and README.md command snippets to uv sync / uv run.
close_reason: uv adopted; hatchling kept; uv.lock committed; docs updated; tests/build verified

title: Visual check: DEM contour lines render legibly (QMapShack/device)
description: topovert-783 added --contours (gdal_contour -> OSM ways, types 0x22 index / 0x21 minor, brown TYP, ele labels). Verified end-to-end on a synthetic LV95 DEM (build succeeds, correct tags/classification) but NOT yet eyeballed on real swissALTI3D in QMapShack/on a Garmin. Confirm: contour colour/weight legible over the hillshade, index vs intermediate distinguishable, ele labels readable, sane density at 20 m. Tune interval/colours/resolutions if needed.

title: swissTLM3D: broaden TAG_MAP (rail, land cover, POIs, barriers)
description: Extend vector.TAG_MAP beyond the rn1 core nav set (roads/water/lakes/buildings) to railways, land cover, single objects/POIs, barriers, etc. Data-only once the rn1 converter machinery lands.
close_reason: Broadened the swissTLM3D tag map (table-driven _KIND_TABLES): added railways (TLM_EISENBAHN), aerialways (TLM_UEBRIGE_BAHN), full land cover (TLM_BODENBEDECKUNG: water/forest/scrub/rock/scree/glacier/wetland), POIs (TLM_EINZELOBJEKT: spring/cave/monument/cross/waterfall/...), and walls (TLM_MAUER). Authoritative OBJEKTART codes from the swisstopo Objektkatalog. Verified end-to-end on sample GDB; 27 tests pass.

title: swissTLM3D: splitter.jar for large extents
description: When swissTLM3D extents are large, mkgmap needs pre-tiling. Add splitter.jar download+cache (mirror jars.ensure_mkgmap pattern) and split features.osm.pbf before mkgmap. Deferred from rn1 slice 1, which targets a bounded perimeter and feeds .osm straight to mkgmap.
close_reason: DEM-optional + splitter implemented and verified end-to-end. Vector-only build derives bounds from the TLM extent (vector.tlm_bounds via ogrinfo + gdaltransform), skips HGT, runs mkgmap without --dem. Large OSM (> SPLIT_NODE_THRESHOLD nodes) is tiled with splitter.jar (auto-downloaded, SHA-pinned) then mkgmap combines tiles into one gmapsupp. Required fixing OSM node ordering for splitter (ascending positive ids, nodes-before-ways). Verified: small sample vector-only (4s) and a 40x30km subset -> 5.16M nodes -> 4 tiles -> 6.8M gmapsupp. 30 tests pass.

title: Area selection / auto-download from swisstopo STAC API
description: Take a bbox/area and download needed swissALTI3D (later swissTLM3D) tiles from swisstopo open-data STAC API instead of requiring local files. Matches README 'easy area selection' vision. Deferred from v1.

title: mkgmap style file for Swiss map rendering
description: Author mkgmap style/typ files mapping Swiss attributes to Garmin rendering for legible topo maps. Inspiration (only): martinzellner/swisstopo-garmin style file (abandoned). Deferred from v1.

title: Contour lines via pyhgtmap
description: Separate elevation branch: swissALTI3D DEM raster → pyhgtmap → OSM contour ways → mkgmap. Complements --dem hillshading. Deferred from v1.
close_reason: Implemented --contours: DEM contour lines via gdal_contour (CLI, not pyhgtmap — keeps zero-pip-dep rule). New contour.py runs gdal_contour (VRT->GPKG) -> ogr2ogr reproject -> GeoJSON -> OSM ways tagged contour=elevation/ele/contour_ext. vector+contour streams share one _IdAllocator; new osm.assemble_osm merges them osmosis-ordered so splitter still works for large extents. Style: lines 0x22 (bold index, every 5th) / 0x21 (intermediate) + brown TYP + ele labels. CLI: --contours/--contour-interval (needs --dem-dir). Verified end-to-end on a synthetic LV95 DEM (18 contours, correct major/minor split, mkgmap build OK). Docs (README+CLAUDE.md) updated; 45 tests pass (5 new in test_contour.py + extended test_style.py). Visual acceptance tracked in topovert-bgb.

title: swissTLM3D vector features via ogr2pbf (+splitter)
description: Add vector map features from swissTLM3D: ogr2pbf converts OGR-readable swissTLM3D (GeoPackage) to .osm.pbf with reprojection 2056→4326; splitter tiles large extents; mkgmap compiles. Needs a tag-translation file mapping swissTLM3D attrs to OSM tags. Deferred from v1.
design: CLI-only (NOT ogr2pbf). ogr2pbf needs compiled osgeo GDAL bindings, which CLAUDE.md deliberately avoids; would drop stdlib-only/zero-dep property. Instead: ogr2ogr -f GeoJSONSeq reprojects swissTLM3D 2056->4326; new src/topovert/vector.py converts GeoJSON->OSM via a data-only TAG_MAP (unit-tested); mkgmap consumes one combined .osm. Slice 1 = core nav set: tlm_strasse->highway, tlm_fliessgewaesser->waterway, tlm_stehende_gewaesser->natural=water, tlm_gebaeude*->building. Splitter deferred.
notes: VERIFIED end-to-end against sample GDB (testdata/.../SWISSTLM3D_CHLV95LN02.gdb) + 10m DEM. Output out/swiss_tlm.img built by mkgmap with: 5862 highway ways (full motorway..path hierarchy + 1 ferry), 196 waterway lines, 36 filled water areas (TLM_BODENBEDECKUNG polys), 15422 buildings. Reconciled mapping to real data: OBJEKTART is integer (codes from swisstopo Objektkatalog), water areas from BODENBEDECKUNG not shoreline lines. 25 unit tests pass. title: Custom Garmin point icons for swissTLM3D POIs
description: The bundled TYP (topovert_typ.txt) styles only lines & polygons; POIs from points (man_made=cross/survey_point, natural=spring/cave_entrance, amenity=fountain, historic=monument/wayside_shrine/boundary_stone, waterway=waterfall, man_made=water_works) currently render with Garmin's default icons for their stock POI type numbers. Add [_point] blocks to the TYP (or remap to types with better stock icons) so summits/springs/caves/monuments get distinct, legible markers. Referenced as the deferred follow-up in src/topovert/styles/topovert/points. Depends on the z0q visual check to know which defaults actually look wrong.

title: swissTLM3D vector: global node dedup / shared-vertex topology
description: Slice 1 emits per-feature nodes with no global dedup (mkgmap tolerates coincident nodes). Add coordinate dedup + shared node ids so connected ways share vertices, shrinking output and improving routing topology.
